notes: Three independent fictional tasks. Do not imply that the same task was registered three times.
Gemini's Calendar integration and DOPAGAKI's Vertex Gemini planning are different stages; no custom Gemini plugin was distributed.
Calendar detail and management view show the same saved plan; their screenshot order does not imply a serial database transaction.
Screenshots contain selected visible UI regions only. Unrelated conversations, calendars, account controls and identifiers were excluded when capturing; content was not redrawn.
The generated manual-input example includes a calendar-entry step inferred from the test title. It is actual model output, not proof that all generated steps are suitable. Users can edit the plan.
These production examples are separate from the 60→70→90 minute local-demo walkthrough in screen-flow.json.
